train_one_epoch: train a stereo or optical flow model for one epoch with gradient accumulation and mixed precision
validate_one_epoch: validate a stereo or flow model across multiple datasets using tiled inference and logging
tiled_pred: run tiled patch-based inference on image pairs with confidence-weighted prediction averaging
split_prediction_conf: split a model prediction tensor into predictions and confidence channels
_overlapping: generate overlapping window slice offsets for tiling an image dimension
